1.outline: Term theme: 'Build a Website + AI Tools'. Plan a multi-page Google Site: what pages it needs, who it's for, and what each page will contain.
1.sowResources: Printed planning sheet, example Google Site.
objectives: Choose a purpose and audience for a website.
Plan the pages needed.
Sketch a simple sitemap.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Look at a real site
plan.detail: Explore an example Google Site and identify its pages and purpose.

plan.title: Plan my site
plan.detail: Choose a topic, purpose and audience; sketch a sitemap with 3 pages.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Pitch the plan to a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: I chose a clear purpose and audience.
My sitemap has three planned pages.
I can pitch my site plan to a partner.

2.outline: Create the pages in Google Sites and add heading and body text to each, following the sitemap.
objectives: Create pages in Google Sites.
Add headings and body text to each page.
Follow the planned sitemap.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the pages
plan.detail: Create three pages and add headings and body text to each, following the plan.

plan.title: Read-through
plan.detail: Read each page aloud — does it make sense? Save and log out.

successCriteria: My site has three pages created.
Each page has a heading and body text.
My pages follow my original plan.

3.outline: Add images to each page and check the navigation menu connects all the pages correctly.
objectives: Insert an image on each page.
Check the navigation menu links to every page.
Resize images so they fit the layout.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add images
plan.detail: Insert a relevant image on each page and resize to fit.

plan.title: Check navigation
plan.detail: Click through the navigation menu to confirm every page is reachable.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: Every page has a relevant image.
My navigation menu reaches every page.
My images are resized to fit the layout.

4.outline: Embed a video or a slide deck into one page of the site, so external content plays directly on the page.
objectives: Embed a video or slide deck into a page.
Check the embed plays or displays correctly.
Explain why embedding is useful.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Embed content
plan.detail: Insert a video or slide embed into a chosen page.

plan.title: Test it
plan.detail: Check the embed plays or displays correctly for a visitor.

plan.title: Discuss
plan.detail: Discuss why embedding is more useful than a plain link. Log out.

successCriteria: I embedded a video or slide deck.
My embed displays or plays correctly.
I can explain why embedding is useful.

5.outline: Under teacher guidance, use an AI tool to generate an image or short text for the site, then edit and credit it correctly.
objectives: Use a guided AI tool to generate content or an image.
Edit the AI output to fit the site.
Credit the AI-made content correctly.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Generate content
plan.detail: Under supervision, generate an image or short text using the guided AI tool.

plan.title: Edit and credit
plan.detail: Edit the AI output to fit the site and add a credit line.

plan.title: Insert it
plan.detail: Insert the credited content into the site. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I generated content or an image using the guided AI tool.
I edited the output to fit my site.
My AI content is correctly credited.

6.subtopic: Make a Fun Tool to Embed
6.outline: Under teacher guidance, build a small fun tool or mini-game using an AI tool, then embed it in the site.
objectives: Use a guided AI tool to build a small tool or game.
Test that it works.
Embed it in the website.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the widget
plan.detail: Under supervision, use the guided AI tool to build a small fun tool or mini-game.

plan.title: Embed it
plan.detail: Embed the finished tool into a chosen page of the site.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: I built a small tool or game with the guided AI tool.
I tested that it works.
It is embedded into my website.

7.outline: Publish the site and review safety and privacy: no personal information, and appropriate sharing settings.
objectives: Publish the finished site.
Check for personal information that shouldn't be public.
Set appropriate sharing/visibility settings.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Privacy sweep
plan.detail: Check every page for personal information (full names, addresses, personal photos) that shouldn't be public.

plan.title: Publish
plan.detail: Publish the site with the correct sharing settings.

plan.title: Peer check
plan.detail: A partner visits the published site and checks it looks right. Log out.

successCriteria: I checked my site for inappropriate personal information.
My site is published with correct settings.
A partner confirmed my published site works.

8.outline: Present the finished website to the class, showing the pages, the AI content and the embedded widget.
objectives: Present the finished website.
Show the AI content and the embedded widget.
Save the site link to the portfolio.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Showcase
plan.detail: Present the site to the class, navigating through its pages.

plan.title: Highlight AI elements
plan.detail: Point out the AI content and the embedded widget and how they were made.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the site link to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my finished website.
I showed and explained the AI content and widget.
My site link is saved to the portfolio folder.

9.outline: Extend the site with a fourth page, applying feedback received during the showcase.
objectives: Add a fourth page to the site.
Apply at least one piece of feedback received.
Re-publish the site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add a page
plan.detail: Add a fourth page and apply at least one piece of showcase feedback.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Re-publish and check the new page appears correctly.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: My site now has a fourth page.
I applied at least one piece of feedback.
My re-published site works correctly.

10.outline: Rehearse the term's site-building skills in pairs: create a page, add media, publish with correct privacy settings.
10.sowResources: Recap slide deck, practice task cards.
objectives: Recall the term's site-building process in order.
Rehearse building and publishing a page with a partner.
Identify the trickiest step.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Process recap
plan.detail: Recap: plan, pages, images, embed, AI, publish — as a class chant.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Build and publish a short page with a partner reading the task card, then swap.

plan.title: Tricky step check
plan.detail: Name the step you still find hardest. Log out.

successCriteria: I can list the term's site-building steps in order.
I rehearsed building and publishing with a partner.
I know which step needs more practice.

11.outline: Individual task: build and publish a 3-page Google Site including one element created with an AI tool, checked for privacy.
objectives: Build a 3-page site.
Include one teacher-guided AI-made element.
Publish with correct privacy settings.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task.

plan.title: Build the site
plan.detail: Individual practical: build 3 pages with text, images and one AI element.

plan.title: Privacy check and publish
plan.detail: Check for personal information, then publish.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Save and celebrate the year's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: My site has 3 complete pages.
My site includes one AI-made, correctly credited element.
My site is published with correct privacy settings.

12.outline: Plan a bigger final site that showcases the whole year's ICT work: a portfolio site with pages for each term.
objectives: Plan a portfolio site covering the whole year.
Decide what work to showcase from each term.
Sketch the sitemap.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Plan the portfolio
plan.detail: Sketch a sitemap with a page per term, choosing the best work to showcase from each.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Tell a partner the plan. Collect plans. Log out.

successCriteria: My plan has a page for each term's work.
I chose specific pieces of work to showcase.
I can tell a partner my plan.

13.outline: Build the portfolio site, adding pages and linking or embedding the best work from across the year.
objectives: Build the portfolio site pages.
Link or embed the year's best work.
Check navigation works between all pages.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the portfolio
plan.detail: Build the pages and link or embed the chosen work from the year.

plan.title: Navigation check
plan.detail: Check every page is reachable and every link works. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My portfolio site has pages for each term.
My best work is linked or embedded.
Navigation works across all pages.

14.outline: Do a final privacy check, publish the portfolio site, and rehearse presenting it.
objectives: Do a final privacy check.
Publish the finished portfolio site.
Rehearse presenting it.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Final privacy check
plan.detail: Check every page one more time for personal information.

plan.title: Publish
plan.detail: Publish the site with correct sharing settings.

plan.title: Rehearse
plan.detail: Practise presenting the portfolio to a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: My portfolio passed a final privacy check.
My portfolio site is published.
I rehearsed presenting it to a partner.

15.outline: Present the finished portfolio site to the class as a celebration of the whole year's ICT work.
objectives: Present the finished portfolio site confidently.
Highlight the best work from across the year.
Reflect on progress made this year.

plan.title: Final rehearsal
plan.detail: One last run-through with a partner before presenting.

plan.title: Year Portfolio Fair
plan.detail: Present portfolio sites to the class in small groups.

plan.title: Save the link
plan.detail: Save the site link into the portfolio folder.

plan.title: Year celebration
plan.detail: Name three things learned this year, ready for Year 6. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my portfolio site confidently.
I highlighted my best work from the year.
I reflected on my progress this year.
